plan.summary: BRO-5582: 1,643 review files carry wrongProduction=true with no record of why. Stamp a behavior-neutral wrongProductionLegacyAudit field (basis, backfilledBy, backfilledAt) so each flag has an audit trail. No flag value, score or auto-clear behavior changes.
steps: Run backfill-wrongproduction-legacy-audit.js with --apply --expect=1643. It fails the run unless exactly 1643 files were written with no write-guard refusals.

actions.description: Stamp the audit field on 1643 legacy wrongProduction flags
